parameters: \r…Be done with your burden.\nLet it go now.
\rFor everything there must be an ending.\nOnly
then…\nOnly then can there be a new beginning.
\rThat is immutable truth that all living things on this
planet, great and small, must accept.
\rWe Draconids have seen it in our history, as you
have seen it in your own life.
\rLet down the great burden you have borne so long
alone…\nSo that you might at last take a step forward
